## Checklist

This project follows the [Engineering Principles](../ENGINEERING_PRINCIPLES.md).
Check what applies to this change; it's fine to leave an item unchecked if it
genuinely doesn't apply.

- [ ] Relevant tests have been added or updated
- [ ] Existing functionality and API compatibility have been considered
- [ ] Relevant builds and tests pass locally
- [ ] Recoverable failures are handled appropriately (no silent failures, no unnecessary crashes)
- [ ] Significant architectural changes and trade-offs are explained below
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where necessary
- [ ] Performance-sensitive changes have been measured (profiling/benchmarks), if applicable
